notes:
v2.4.1 fixes Report a Bug and lets you see an account's transactions from the Chart of Accounts.

Report a Bug (Settings → Help) works again. Reports had been failing with "HTTP Error 401"; they now go through the Dogbox licence server.

Chart of Accounts: click an account to see every transaction with a running balance. Pick This FY, Last FY, All or your own dates, open any journal entry, or download the list as CSV.

Also: an account's transactions from a start date with no end date no longer double-count earlier transactions.
